title: Shaad Rahe Karbala
body:
hussain hussain hussain hussain
hussaina hussaina hussaina
maula mere maula mere maula
<<DIVIDER>>
bachpan se tumhara mai azaadar hoo maula
ghar ghar mein sada aap ka farshe aza dekha
main is se juda reh nahi sakta
ye majlis o matam rahe maula
ye dil ki dua hai ye dil ki dua hai
yeh dil ki dua dil ki dua hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaad rahe karbala abaad rahe karbala
dil ki ye dua hai ya hussain
silsila dar silsila silsila dar silsila
jaari rahe ye sada hussain
shaad rahe karbala abaad rahe karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
badshaah hussain ki saltanat hai karbala
jis ka paasban hai maula ghazi bawafa
aap ne hussain bakhuda
khoon se saja di karbala
karbala ki ay khuda shaan ye rahe sada
dil ki ye dua hai ya hussain
shaad rahe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
janaat e maa karbala
raahat e maa karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
maula ne basa diya aisa shehr karbala
jis ki khaak bhi shifa jis ki jannati fiza
doosri na hogi karbala
hoga na hussain doosra
honge na kabhi juda ab hussain o karbala
dil ki ye dua hai ya hussain
shaad rahe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhadkano mein ba khuda goonjti hai karbala
har sada mein jaa baja bolti hai karbala
kehta hai zamana ya hussain
ya hussain hussain hussain hussain
gham tumhara ho sada ay shaheed e karbala
dil ki ye dua hai ya hussain
shaad rahe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
janaat e maa karbala
raahat e maa karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ko waledayn ne karbala batayi hai
saath le gaye hamein karbala dikhayi hai
ziyaratein na bhool payenge
din hmein wo yaad aayenge
hai khuda se iltija sab ko karbala dikha
dil ki ye dua hai ya hussain
shaad rahe karbala...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindabad ya hussain ya hussain zindabad
panjatan ke paanchwe noor e ain zidabad
marhaba hussain marhaba aap ne kamaal kar diya
azmaton ke badshaah aap ki rahe ataa
dil ki ye dua hai ya hussain
shaad rahe karbala...
author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri
